description: A pint of raw ether and a rag. Not the smart choice, but here we are.

events.text: [trip]The floor lurches sideways and the room smears into long cold streaks.[/trip]
[trip]Your thoughts arrive out of order, each one wrapped in cotton wool.[/trip]
[trip]You are extremely far away from your own hands.[/trip]
[trip]A chemical wind blows straight through your skull and out the other side.[/trip]
[trip]The room swings queasily back into place, reeking of solvent, and you with it.[/trip]

overdose.message: You breathe in one rag too many. The lights go out mid-thought.

effects.comeon_message: You put the rag over your face and breathe in. The smell is the whole world for a second.
effects.onset_message: The floor tilts politely away and the lights go soft at the edges.
effects.take_line: You soak the rag and hold it over your face.

name: ether
